task: video-eval-001: real-source video clips for keyframe-retrieval questions
license_note: All three sources are Blender Foundation open movies / trailers under CC-BY 3.0 (attribution: © Blender Foundation, blender.org). Excerpts are re-encoded (H.264, no audio) — the license permits derivative excerpts with attribution.

clips.source_title: Big Buck Bunny (2008, Blender Foundation, CC-BY 3.0)
clips.excerpt_command: ffmpeg -ss 120 -t 40 -i big_buck_bunny_360p.mp4 -an -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -crf 22 -pix_fmt yuv420p -threads 1 bbb-excerpt.mp4
clips.content_anchor: excerpt covers source 120-160s: the meadow/forest stretch after the intro; keyframe contact sheets in reports/execution/video-eval-001/

clips.excerpt_command: ffmpeg -ss 480 -t 40 -i ed_1024_512kb.mp4 -an -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -crf 22 -pix_fmt yuv420p -threads 1 ed-excerpt.mp4
clips.content_anchor: excerpt covers source 480-520s: the second half inside the surreal machine world; keyframe contact sheets in reports/execution/video-eval-001/

clips.excerpt_command: ffmpeg -ss 20 -i sintel_trailer-480p.mp4 -an -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -crf 22 -pix_fmt yuv420p -threads 1 sintel-excerpt.mp4
clips.content_anchor: excerpt covers the trailer from 20s to end (studio logo head excluded); keyframe contact sheets in reports/execution/video-eval-001/

clips.source_title: Elephants Dream (2006, Blender Foundation, CC-BY 3.0) — second excerpt (opening loft sequence)
clips.excerpt_command: ffmpeg -ss 0 -t 40 -i ed_1024_512kb.mp4 -an -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -crf 22 -pix_fmt yuv420p -threads 1 ed2-excerpt.mp4
clips.content_anchor: excerpt covers source 0-40s: the loft/workshop opening with the round machine; added at construction because the machine-interior excerpt dominated primary-segment selection

design_notes: no audio (-an): the frame-retrieval path is under test; speech routing is already covered by the asr-tagged questions — this also removes the transcript-leak class entirely
filenames carry only source acronyms (bbb/ed/sintel); captions and questions must not use them (checked at authoring)
studio-logo heads/tails excluded from every excerpt (cross-clip near-duplicate keyframes)
